This revelation sheds new light on Lenzi's professional background, providing insight into his career trajectory and expertise. According to data from the French National Institute for Statistics and Economic Studies (INSEE), "anciens cadres" refers to a specific socio-professional category comprising individuals who have held senior management or executive positions in the past. This category is characterized by high levels of education, experience, and leadership skills. Our research indicates that Jean-Marie Lenzi's professional history aligns with the criteria defining "anciens cadres." In conclusion, our investigation has established that Jean-Marie Lenzi indeed works as an "ancien cadre," a socio-professional category characterized by senior management experience, high levels of education, and leadership skills.
